ai_infrastructure.reason: Six-company official evidence supports continued AI infrastructure expansion.

ai_capex.reason: Six-company official evidence supports continued AI capital-spending expansion.

ai_adoption.reason: Six-company official evidence supports continued enterprise and consumer AI adoption.

independent_demand_quality.reason: Supplier-supported purchases and circular-financing exposure are down-weighted rather than counted as independent demand.

capital_efficiency.reason: Cash-flow conversion and AI monetization have not yet fully caught up with gross capital-spending growth.

overall.reason: AI expansion remains intact, but demand quality and capital efficiency require monitoring.

signal_methodology.ai_capex: Measure disclosed spending, but do not treat supplier-financed purchases as independent end demand.
signal_methodology.independent_demand_quality: Down-weight purchases supported by supplier loans, equity investments, guarantees, purchase commitments, or equivalent financing. Do not double count supplier revenue and customer capex as two independent demand signals.
signal_methodology.capital_efficiency: Evaluate operating cash flow, free cash flow, and commercialization separately from gross capex.
